lines.text: I am telling, each, everyone That He arose and iives And He is in our midst here too By His quickening Spirit.
Tell it to your neighbour also That they may rise with us That light may shine all round about Through all our days on earth.
This world doth now have a foretaste Of Father’s home on high The new life that His grace imparts Makes it an heavenly place.
The way of the grave that He trod Leads us on to the skies Who ever follows His footsteps Will go to Him in heaven.
He is alive and here with us To the ends of the world And when this mortal frame we yield Back to the dust, in hope.
